# Young Agrarians

> Young Agrarians is a farmer-to-farmer educational network supporting new and young ecological farmers across Canada through apprenticeships, land matching, mentorship, and community learning.

Young Agrarians operates across British Columbia, Alberta, and other Canadian regions, connecting aspiring farmers with land, mentors, and training in regenerative and organic agriculture. The organization combines hands-on apprenticeships, digital platforms, and policy advocacy to address barriers to farm entry and renewal.

## Core Programs

- [Programs - Young Agrarians](https://youngagrarians.org/programs): Overview of apprenticeship, land matching & mentorship programs for new farmers
- [Young Agrarians Farm Apprenticeship Program](https://youngagrarians.org/programs/apprenticeship-program): Farm Apprenticeship Program providing hands-on regenerative farming training
- [B.C. Land Matching Program - Young Agrarians](https://youngagrarians.org/programs/bc-land-matching-program): B.C. Land Matching Program connecting farmers & landowners for farm access
- [Alberta Land Matching Program - Young Agrarians](https://youngagrarians.org/programs/alberta-land-matching-program): Alberta Land Matching Program supporting new farmers & landowner connections
- [Business Mentorship Network (BMN) - Young Agrarians](https://youngagrarians.org/programs/business-mentorship-network): BMN pairing new & seasoned farmers for sustainable business development

## Learning & Events

- [Young Agrarians Events](https://youngagrarians.org/programs/events): Events calendar with mixers, workshops & farm tours across Canadian regions
- [E-Learning - Young Agrarians](https://youngagrarians.org/programs/e-learning): Online courses on farming basics, business planning & land access for new farmers
